description: This file is a C source file that implements a sample server for RBUS (Remote Bus) framework. It includes functions for handling get and set requests, message callbacks, object registration, event registration, and a main loop for publishing events. It demonstrates how to set up RBUS objects, methods, events, and message handling in a C environment.

methods.name: int handle_get(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Handles get requests by initializing the response message, printing debug info, and setting success status and user data string.

methods.name: int handle_set(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Handles set requests by extracting string from request and updating user data.

methods.name: int callback(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage message,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Generic message callback that prints received message details.

methods.name: int sub_callback(const char * object,const char * event,const char * listener,int added,const rbusMessage filter,void * data)
methods.description: Subscription callback that logs object, event, listener, added/removed status, and data.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Main function setting up RBUS objects, methods, events, and repeatedly publishing events.
